notes: Prior Home-Decor pass (archive c223) found simons.ca fully Cloudflare-blocked over HTTP and was forced to use Wayback (structure only, qty nulled per project Rule 2). This pass reached the live site directly and cleanly through the Claude-in-Chrome connector: robots.txt (live, User-agent: *, Allow: /, no Claude-specific disallow), homepage, and every category page loaded normally with no Cloudflare interstitial encountered at any point. Tree source: fetched /sitemap.xml -> /sitemap/www-ca/categorySitemap-en.xml (8368 category URLs, same-origin fetch from the loaded page context) and regex-filtered for furniture keywords, then cross-checked against the live Furniture department root page's own sub-nav link list (https://www.simons.ca/en/furniture--9867) -- both sources agree exactly: 8 direct children (Chairs & Stools, Tables, Storage, Bedroom Furniture as sub-groups; TV Stands & Media Units, Office Furniture, Couches/Sofas/Armchairs, Outdoor Furniture as direct leaves), plus 'All Our Furniture' (Shop All) and 'Furniture New Arrivals' which were excluded per the navigation-junk rule (Section 3). Also checked Bathroom (--6823), Kids (--6949) and Decor (--6771) departments' full child lists in the category sitemap for stray furniture nodes: Bathroom has no vanity/furniture node (only towels/rugs/curtains/accessories/storage baskets); Kids/bedroom--6950 renders as 'Kids Bedding' (confirmed via live h1) not furniture -- no dedicated kids furniture category exists on this site. Qty method: every leaf page embeds a live DOM element div.js-categoryPager[data-products="N"]. Spot-checked on the Poufs page (https://www.simons.ca/en/decor/poufs--8317) against two independent live sources in the same load: the rendered on-page label .categoryFilters-productCount ('55 items') and an actual DOM count of .product_card elements (55) -- all three agreed exactly, confirming this attribute is the site's true per-node count (not padded/inflated the way OTTO or Muuto were). Used this data-products value as qty for every row, citing the corroboration in each evidence string; the rendered '<N> items' label is present in the DOM on every category page using the same template. Every leaf fetch also captured the page's own <h1> and confirmed it matched the requested node name (guards against the bad-slug-serves-parent trap) -- all matched. Duplicate-URL check: /en/outdoor/outdoor-furniture--1005 (Outdoor department) 200s but its own canonical link tag points to /en/furniture/outdoor-furniture--9887 and both show identical data-products=104 -- same node under two URLs; only the Furniture-department canonical URL was recorded, the Outdoor-department alias was dropped as a duplicate. One ambiguous inclusion, flagged: Poufs & Ottomans (https://www.simons.ca/en/decor/poufs--8317, qty 55) is filed under the site's Decor department, not Furniture, and its own description explicitly mixes genuine seating furniture (ottomans, beanbag chairs) with non-furniture items (floor cushions, inflatable/floating outdoor pool poufs). Per the brief's product-type-over-website-category priority rule poufs/ottomans are seating furniture, but given the site's own department placement and the confirmed non-furniture content mixed into this single node, it is included with a MANUAL REVIEW flag rather than silently included or dropped. No French-only or other-locale furniture nodes found; the category sitemap covers both locales by shared numeric IDs.
